content: Leví-waganga neggweburmar-uklesad
Bab-Jehová Jordán-diwar-naba Moab-nebagan-naidgi Jericó-neggwebur-asabin Moisésʼga sunmakded, ega sogded:
“Israel-dulemarga be soge: ‘Yar-gamaloedgine, Leví-waganga neggweburmar be ukmogoye, adi, agi na maigumarmogagar. A-neggweburmar-dikarba gagan-nainumar-nanaid ega be ukbalo.
We-Leví-wagana na neggweburmar-nikumaloedgi maigumaloed, degine, gagan-nainumar-ega-uklegoedgi na e-moli-bebe-nikamalad, e-sibadmar, e-sibad-wawaadmar, degi, bela e-ibdurgan ambikumaloed.

” ’We-Leví-waganga gagan-nainumar-uklegoedi, neggwebur-galu-matusulid-dakasik bela neggwebur-ebiris ega uklegoed. Galu-matusulidgine, dali-dulataled-ilabo gaka dulabo-gakambe-banguedgi (250) ega be ukmaloed.

” ’Leví-waganga-neggweburmar-uklegoedi, gwanergwa (6) dukumalad-neggweburga guoed. Adi, dule-gwensak emar-gindaksale, a-neggweburmarse dukunaoed. De-ukinbali, we-neggwebur-gwanergwad-uklegoed-ukine gwadulabo-gakabo (42) neggweburmar-baigan ega be ukbaloed.
Belamakale, ega gwadulabo gakabaabak (48) neggweburmar be ukoed. Degi, e-gagan-nainumar-nika-nika ega be ukoed.

Israel-dulemar Leví-waganga neggweburmar-ukarmalale, neggwebur-susmaladbali ega ukoed. Dule neggwebur-bukidar-susale, ega neggwebur ichesur ukmogoed. Ar dule ichee neggwebur-susardi, ichee ega ukmogoed. Bela Israel-dulemala na e-neggwebur-merguedba Leví-waganga neggweburmar-ukoed.’ ”
Dukued-neggweburmar
Bab-Jehová Moisésʼga sunmakded, ega sogded:
“Israel-dulemarga be sunmak, ega be soge: ‘Bemar Jordán-diwar-obaksamalale, Canaán-yalase-dogdapmalale,
dukued-neggweburmar be suo. Adi, dule, dule-baid-oburgwebiedba-oburgwidsulid, ase dukunaegar.
Degisoggu, we-dule, a-neggweburmargi dule-buged-e-imakbied-idu dukuoed. Adi, dule-gindakedi melle Israel-dulemar-abin ega igar-itolessuli oburgwilegegar.
” ’Neggweburmar-uklegoedi, gwanergwa (6) dukued-neggweburga be imakoed.
Neggwebur-gwapaa Jordán-diwar-dad-nakwedsik bukwa guoed, neggwebur-baigan-gwapaa Canaán-yalagi bukwa gumogoed.

We-neggweburmar-gwanergwadi (6) Israel-dulemarga, dukued-negga guoed. Degi, dule-ainebarmaladga dukued-negga guoed. Ar we-dule-ainebalidi bemar-abargi mamaidibe, igi sikwas-bemar-walik gudimardibe, amarga dukued-negga guoed. Ar dule, dule-baid-oburgwebisulidba-oburgwisad, ase dukunaoed.
” ’Dule-gwensak esgorogi dule-baid-sarsosale, dule-sarsolesad burgwisale, soglegoed, we-dule-gwensak dule-gindakedye. We-dule, oburgwilemogoed.
” ’Dule-gwensak akwagi dule-baid-sarsosale, dule-sarsolesad burgwisale, soglegoed, we-dule-gwensak dule-gindakedye. We-dule, oburgwilemogoed.
” ’Dule-gwensak suargi dule-baid-sarsosale, dule-sarsolesad burgwisale, soglegoed, we-dule-gwensak dule-gindakedye. We-dule, oburgwilemogoed.
” ’Dule-gindaklesad-e-gwenadi, e-gwenad-gindaksad-abingualile, gindakoed, buged-mai imakoed.
” ’Dule-gwensak yamo isdar-dakedba dule-baid-barmetele, igi, yamo egi ibmar-metele, dule burgwenonikile,

degi, yamo isdar-dakedba sabsur-sarsosale, we-dule burgwenonikile, soglegoed, we-dule-gwensak dule-gindakedye. We-dule, oburgwilemogoed. Ar dule-buged-mai-imakbied we-dule-gindaksad-abingualirdi, dule-gindaksad ese oburgwilegoed.
” ’Dule-gwensak isdar-daksulidba dule-baid-barmetele, igi, baisur-binsaedgi egi ibmar-metele,
degi, baisur-binsaedgi egi akwa metele, we-dule burgwenonikile, degi-inigwele, we-dule-gwensak e-isdaradsulid, deginbali, gwen oburgwebisulidba-oburgwisad.
A-ulale, dulemala, we-dule-gwensakga, degi, dule-buged-mai-imakbiedga igar-maidba igar-itomaloed.

Israel-dulemar dule-gindaksad dule-buged-mai-imakbiedgi bendakoed. Dule-gindaksad na bia dukued-neggweburse-dukuapidse gannar naoed. We-dule-gwensak-dule-gindaksad, dule-irwa-Bab-Dummadse-goled-bur-dummadga-maid-burgwedse, na e-neggweburse dagoed. We-dule-irwa-Bab-Dummadse-goledi Bab-Dummadga-arbaega olivo-gwallu egi eolesad.
” ’Ar dule-gindaksadi e-dukumaid-neggwebur-abingunaidgi nodele,
dule-buged-mai-imakbied dukued-neggwebur-abingunaidgi dule-gindaksad-abingualile, sunna dule-gindaksad-oburgwed. Ar dule-buged-imakedgi ataklegosulid.

Ar ade, dule-gwensak-dule-gindaksadi, dule-irwa-Bab-Dummadse-goled-bur-dummad-burgwedse, dukued-neggweburgi maigu-guewilubbid. Dule-irwa-Bab-Dummadse-goled-bur-dummad-burgwisale, geb dule-gindaksad na e-negse gannar nonikoed.’ ”
Dule e-sunnad ibmar-daksad-igar
Bab-Jehová sogdebalid: “Bia be bukwamalale, bemarga, degi, be-waganga weyobi degisadegu we-igar mai guoed.
”Dule-wargwen, dule-baid-oburgwisale, igi-e-daksamalad-sogoe, aba oburgwilegoed. Degi-inigwele, dule-wargwen-sogedbarbi dule-oburgwilegosulid.
”Dule-gindaked manigi onolegosulid, ar ade, oburgwilegoye ega igar maid. Ar we-dulede, oburgwilegergebed.
”Deginbali, dule dukued-neggweburse-dukunadedi gannar e-neggweburse-dagega mani-ukosulid. Dule-irwa-Bab-Dummadse-goled-bur-dummad-burgwisar, geb we-dule gannar na e-negse dagoed.
”Bemar-ambikumaloed-yala, melle dule-gindaklegedgi oichogo. Ar dule-gindaklegedi yar-oichoged. Bur dule-emar-gindaked-obeloerdi nabirdo. Adi, degidbali, nueganbi yar nai guoed.
”Ar an bemar-abargi gudisoggu, bemar-megmaloedgi melle napa oichomalo. Ar ade, ani, Bab-Jehová, Israel-dulemar-abargi an gudiid.”
